title: Mike Macdonald explains how Seahawks used social media to scout Broncos in 2024

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Macdonald explains how Seahawks used social media to scout Broncos in 2024
sources.description: Mike Macdonald said that Sean Payton was threatening to accuse the Seahawks of cheating after the team scouted plays from fan videos at training camp.
